import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Greenberg's conjectures

Greenberg's invariants conjecture concerns the class numbers in cyclotomic
$\mathbb Z_\ell$-extensions of totally real number fields.

*Reference:* [Wikipedia, Greenberg's conjectures](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greenberg%27s_conjectures)
-/

namespace GreenbergsConjectures

open Module NumberField

/--
**Greenberg's invariants conjecture.** Let $k$ be a totally real number field and let
$\ell$ be a prime. If $k_n$ is the degree-$\ell^n$ layer of the cyclotomic
$\mathbb Z_\ell$-extension of $k$, then the exponent of $\ell$ in the class number of
$k_n$ is bounded independently of $n$. Equivalently, the Iwasawa invariants satisfy
$\lambda_\ell(k)=\mu_\ell(k)=0$.

Here the layers are represented as nested, totally real intermediate fields in a fixed
algebraic closure of $k$. Requiring them to be cyclic Galois of degree $\ell^n$ and to
lie in fields generated by $\ell$-power roots of unity identifies the cyclotomic tower.
-/
@[category research open, AMS 11]
theorem greenbergs_conjectures.parts.i :
    ∀ (k : Type) [Field k] [NumberField k] [IsTotallyReal k]
      (ell : ℕ), ell.Prime →
      ∀ (K : ℕ → IntermediateField k (AlgebraicClosure k))
        [∀ n, FiniteDimensional k (K n)] [∀ n, NumberField (K n)]
        [∀ n, IsTotallyReal (K n)],
        K 0 = ⊥ → Monotone K →
        (∀ n, finrank k (K n) = ell ^ n ∧ IsGalois k (K n) ∧
          IsCyclic (K n ≃ₐ[k] K n) ∧
          ∃ r : ℕ, K n ≤ IntermediateField.adjoin k
            {z : AlgebraicClosure k | IsPrimitiveRoot z (ell ^ r)}) →
        ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ n, padicValNat ell (classNumber (K n)) ≤ C := by
  sorry

end GreenbergsConjectures
modeling_decisions: Used the 1976 bounded-class-number formulation of Greenberg's invariants conjecture because Mathlib has number-field class numbers and p-adic valuations but no Iwasawa lambda or mu invariants.

Represented the cyclotomic Z_ell-extension layers as a monotone family of intermediate fields in a fixed algebraic closure of k, starting at k, each totally real and cyclic Galois of degree ell^n, and each contained in a field generated by ell-power roots of unity. Restricting to ell-power cyclotomic fields is essential; allowing arbitrary roots of unity would include unrelated cyclic extensions.

Required the layers to be totally real. This is true for the cyclotomic Z_ell-extension of a totally real field and, in particular, selects the intended tower in the ell = 2 case, where the full 2-power cyclotomic union has extra finite torsion.
Expressed the exact exponent of ell dividing the class number as `padicValNat ell (NumberField.classNumber (K n))`, and expressed boundedness by one natural bound valid for every layer.

Omitted the generalized pseudo-null slot rather than adopting the Wikipedia article's totally-real-only wording or inventing placeholders. The decomposition requests the arbitrary-number-field source formulation, but neither that formulation nor the narrower article formulation is representable with existing primitives.
Quantified t >= 1 would have been used for the p-rationality conjecture, in accordance with Greenberg's source, if p-rationality itself could have been faithfully defined.

greenbergs_conjectures.parts.ii.why: Faithfully defining p-rationality requires the maximal pro-p extension unramified outside p and freeness of its pro-p Galois group (or the equivalent Leopoldt and torsion formulation). The available libraries lack the arithmetic maximal pro-p extension, free pro-p group, and Leopoldt primitives, so introducing merely an opaque or unconstrained predicate would be unfaithful.

greenbergs_conjectures.variants.pseudo_n.why: A faithful statement requires the compositum of all Z_p-extensions of a number field, its maximal unramified abelian pro-p extension, the resulting Galois group, a completed group algebra/Iwasawa algebra action, and pseudo-nullity of a module. Mathlib and FormalConjecturesForMathlib do not provide these arithmetic pro-p extension and completed-module primitives; an unconstrained replacement predicate would not formalize the conjecture.

/-!

This file states Greenberg's invariants conjecture using its equivalent bounded-class-number
formulation for the finite layers of the cyclotomic $\mathbb{Z}_\ell$-extension.

*Reference:* [Wikipedia, Greenberg's conjectures](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greenberg%27s_conjectures)
-/

open NumberField

namespace GreenbergsConjectures

/-- A finite layer of degree $\ell^n$ in the cyclotomic $\mathbb{Z}_\ell$-extension of a totally
real number field `k`. The embedding condition places the layer in the union of the fields
$k(\mu_{\ell^m})$. Requiring the layer itself to be totally real selects the cyclotomic
$\mathbb{Z}_\ell$-tower, including when $\ell = 2$. -/
def IsCyclotomicZPowerLayer (k K : Type*) [Field k] [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    [FiniteDimensional k K] (ℓ n : ℕ) : Prop :=
  IsGalois k K ∧ IsCyclic (K ≃ₐ[k] K) ∧ Module.finrank k K = ℓ ^ n ∧
    IsTotallyReal K ∧ ∃ m : ℕ, Nonempty (K →ₐ[k] CyclotomicField (ℓ ^ m) k)

/-- **Greenberg's invariants conjecture.** For every totally real number field $k$ and every
prime $\ell$, the $\ell$-adic valuations of the class numbers of the finite layers $k_n$ in the
cyclotomic $\mathbb{Z}_\ell$-extension of $k$ are bounded independently of $n$. Equivalently,
the Iwasawa invariants $\lambda_\ell(k)$ and $\mu_\ell(k)$ both vanish. -/
@[category research open, AMS 11]
theorem greenbergs_conjectures.parts.i :
    ∀ (k : Type) (_ : Field k) (_ : NumberField k) (_ : IsTotallyReal k)
      (ℓ : ℕ), ℓ.Prime →
      ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ (n : ℕ) (K : Type) (_ : Field K) (_ : NumberField K)
        (_ : Algebra k K) (_ : FiniteDimensional k K),
        IsCyclotomicZPowerLayer k K ℓ n → padicValNat ℓ (classNumber K) ≤ C := by
  sorry

end GreenbergsConjectures

A finite layer is characterized up to k-isomorphism as a totally real cyclic Galois extension of degree l^n that embeds over k into k(mu_{l^m}) for some m. Total reality selects the cyclotomic Z_l branch and is especially important at l = 2.
The bound is quantified after the totally real base field and prime, but before the layer index and layer field, so one constant works throughout the tower.

The generalized pseudo-null slot would be interpreted for arbitrary number fields, following the decomposition notes and Greenberg's 2001 formulation rather than Wikipedia's narrower totally real wording, but it is omitted because the required primitives are absent.
The p-rationality slot would quantify over t >= 1 as specified by the source notes, but it is omitted because p-rationality cannot currently be defined faithfully.

import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Greenberg's conjectures

Two conjectures of Ralph Greenberg in algebraic number theory.

* **Greenberg's invariants conjecture** (1971/1976): for every totally real number field $K$ and
  every prime $\ell$, the Iwasawa invariants of the cyclotomic $\mathbb{Z}_\ell$-extension
  $K_\infty/K$ vanish, $\lambda_\ell(K) = \mu_\ell(K) = 0$. Equivalently, the exact power of
  $\ell$ dividing the class number of the $n$-th layer $K_n$ of $K_\infty/K$ is bounded as
  $n \to \infty$.
* **Greenberg's $p$-rationality conjecture** (2016): for every odd prime $p$ and every $t$,
  there is a $p$-rational number field $K$ with $\operatorname{Gal}(K/\mathbb{Q}) \cong
  (\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^t$.

*References:*
* [Wikipedia, Greenberg's conjectures](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greenberg%27s_conjectures)
* [Wikipedia, List of unsolved problems in mathematics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_unsolved_problems_in_mathematics)
* R. Greenberg, *On the Iwasawa invariants of totally real number fields*,
  Amer. J. Math. 98 (1976), 263–284.
* R. Greenberg, *Galois representations with open image*, Ann. Math. Québec 40 (2016), 83–119.
* A. Movahhedi, T. Nguyen Quang Do, *Sur l'arithmétique des corps de nombres $p$-rationnels*,
  Séminaire de Théorie des Nombres, Paris 1987–88, Progr. Math. 81 (1990), 155–200.
-/

open NumberField NumberField.InfinitePlace IsDedekindDomain

namespace GreenbergsConjectures

/--
**Greenberg's invariants conjecture** (Greenberg, 1971/1976). Let $K$ be a totally real number
field and let $\ell$ be a prime. Let $K = K_0 \subset K_1 \subset K_2 \subset \cdots$ be the
layers of the cyclotomic $\mathbb{Z}_\ell$-extension $K_\infty/K$, so that $K_n/K$ is cyclic of
degree $\ell^n$. Then the Iwasawa invariants $\lambda_\ell(K)$ and $\mu_\ell(K)$ vanish;
equivalently (by Iwasawa's formula $e_n = \lambda n + \mu \ell^n + \nu$ for $n \gg 0$), the exact
power $\ell^{e_n}$ of $\ell$ dividing the class number of $K_n$ is bounded as $n \to \infty$.

Here $K_\infty = K \cdot \mathbb{Q}_\infty$, where $\mathbb{Q}_\infty \subseteq
\mathbb{Q}(\mu_{\ell^\infty})$ is the unique $\mathbb{Z}_\ell$-extension of $\mathbb{Q}$, and
$K_n$ is the unique subfield of $K_\infty$ with $[K_n : K] = \ell^n$. We do not construct
$K_\infty$ explicitly. Instead `E` ranges over the totally real intermediate fields of
$K(\mu_{\ell^N})/K$ of degree $\ell^n$ over $K$, for all $N$ and $n$; these are exactly the
layers $K_n$. Indeed, let $H = \operatorname{Gal}(K(\mu_{\ell^\infty})/K) \subseteq
\mathbb{Z}_\ell^\times$, so that $K_\infty$ is the fixed field of the torsion subgroup of $H$.
For odd $\ell$ this torsion has order dividing $\ell - 1$, so it fixes every subextension of
$\ell$-power degree; for $\ell = 2$ it is generated by $\zeta \mapsto \zeta^{-1}$, which is the
restriction of complex conjugation for every complex embedding, so it fixes exactly the totally
real subfields. In both cases such an $E$ lies in $K_\infty$ and hence equals $K_n$; conversely
each $K_n$ is a totally real subfield of some $K(\mu_{\ell^N})$ of degree $\ell^n$ over $K$.
-/
@[category research open, AMS 11]
theorem greenbergs_conjectures.parts.i (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K] [IsTotallyReal K]
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] :
    ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ (n N : ℕ) (E : IntermediateField K (CyclotomicField (ℓ ^ N) K)),
      IsTotallyReal E → Module.finrank K E = ℓ ^ n → padicValNat ℓ (classNumber E) ≤ C := by
  sorry

section PRational

variable (p : ℕ) (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K]

/--
A finite extension `F/K` of number fields is *unramified outside `p`* if every nonzero prime
ideal `P` of `𝓞 F` with `p ∉ P` (i.e. `P` does not lie above `p`) is unramified over `𝓞 K`.
By `Algebra.isUnramifiedAt_iff_of_isDedekindDomain` this says exactly that all such `P` have
ramification index `1` over `𝓞 K`. Infinite places are not considered; this is the standard
convention for odd `p`, where a `p`-extension is automatically unramified at infinite places.
-/
def IsUnramifiedOutside (F : Type*) [Field F] [NumberField F] [Algebra K F] : Prop :=
  ∀ P : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 F), (p : 𝓞 F) ∉ P.asIdeal → Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt (𝓞 K) P.asIdeal

/--
The maximal abelian pro-`p` extension of the number field `K` unramified outside `p`, realised
inside an algebraic closure of `K` as the compositum of all finite abelian extensions `F/K` of
`p`-power degree which are unramified outside `p`.
-/
noncomputable def maxAbelianProPExtUnramifiedOutside : IntermediateField K (AlgebraicClosure K) :=
  sSup {F | ∃ _ : FiniteDimensional K F,
    haveI := NumberField.of_module_finite K F
    IsGalois K F ∧ IsMulCommutative (F ≃ₐ[K] F) ∧ IsPGroup p (F ≃ₐ[K] F) ∧
      IsUnramifiedOutside p K F}

/--
A number field `K` is *`p`-rational* (Movahhedi–Nguyen Quang Do) if the Galois group of the
maximal pro-`p` extension of `K` unramified outside `p` is a free pro-`p` group. For odd `p`
this is equivalent (Movahhedi–Nguyen Quang Do; this is the form used by Greenberg) to the
following statement, which we take as the definition: the Galois group of the maximal *abelian*
pro-`p` extension `M` of `K` unramified outside `p` is isomorphic, as a topological group, to
$\mathbb{Z}_p^{r_2 + 1}$, where $r_2$ is the number of complex places of `K`. (In general
$\operatorname{Gal}(M/K) \cong \mathbb{Z}_p^{r_2 + 1 + \delta} \oplus T$ with $\delta$ the
Leopoldt defect and $T$ finite, so this says precisely that Leopoldt's conjecture holds for
`K` and `p` and that $T$ is trivial.) The Galois group carries the Krull topology.
-/
def IsPRational [Fact p.Prime] : Prop :=
  Nonempty ((maxAbelianProPExtUnramifiedOutside p K ≃ₐ[K] maxAbelianProPExtUnramifiedOutside p K)
    ≃ₜ* Multiplicative (Fin (nrComplexPlaces K + 1) → ℤ_[p]))

/--
Sanity check for the definition: $\mathbb{Q}$ is $p$-rational for every odd prime $p$. Indeed, by
the Kronecker–Weber theorem the maximal abelian pro-$p$ extension of $\mathbb{Q}$ unramified
outside $p$ is the cyclotomic $\mathbb{Z}_p$-extension, whose Galois group is $\mathbb{Z}_p$.
-/
@[category test, AMS 11]
theorem isPRational_rat [Fact p.Prime] (hp : Odd p) : IsPRational p ℚ := by
  sorry

end PRational

/--
**Greenberg's $p$-rationality conjecture** (Greenberg, 2016, Conjecture 4.2.1). For every odd
prime $p$ and every $t$, there exists a $p$-rational number field $K$, Galois over $\mathbb{Q}$,
with $\operatorname{Gal}(K/\mathbb{Q}) \cong (\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^t$.

The case $t = 0$ is included; it holds with $K = \mathbb{Q}$.
-/
@[category research open, AMS 11]
theorem greenbergs_conjectures.parts.ii (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hp : Odd p) (t : ℕ) :
    ∃ (K : Type) (_ : Field K) (_ : NumberField K), IsGalois ℚ K ∧
      Nonempty ((K ≃ₐ[ℚ] K) ≃* Multiplicative (Fin t → ZMod 2)) ∧ IsPRational p K := by
  sorry

end GreenbergsConjectures

Also, the pseudo_null slot is not formalizable with current primitives (see per_slot).

/--
**Greenberg's invariants conjecture** (Greenberg, 1971/1976). Let $K$ be a totally real number
field and let $\ell$ be a prime. Let $K = K_0 \subset K_1 \subset K_2 \subset \cdots$ be the
layers of the cyclotomic $\mathbb{Z}_\ell$-extension $K_\infty/K$, so that $K_n/K$ is cyclic of
degree $\ell^n$. Then the Iwasawa invariants $\lambda_\ell(K)$ and $\mu_\ell(K)$ vanish;
equivalently (by Iwasawa's formula $e_n = \lambda n + \mu \ell^n + \nu$ for $n \gg 0$), the exact
power $\ell^{e_n}$ of $\ell$ dividing the class number of $K_n$ is bounded as $n \to \infty$.

Here $K_\infty = K \cdot \mathbb{Q}_\infty$, where $\mathbb{Q}_\infty \subseteq
\mathbb{Q}(\mu_{\ell^\infty})$ is the unique $\mathbb{Z}_\ell$-extension of $\mathbb{Q}$, and
$K_n$ is the unique subfield of $K_\infty$ with $[K_n : K] = \ell^n$. We do not construct
$K_\infty$ explicitly. Instead `E` ranges over the totally real intermediate fields of
$K(\mu_{\ell^N})/K$ of degree $\ell^n$ over $K$, for all $N$ and $n$; these are exactly the
layers $K_n$. Indeed, let $H = \operatorname{Gal}(K(\mu_{\ell^\infty})/K) \subseteq
\mathbb{Z}_\ell^\times$, so that $K_\infty$ is the fixed field of the torsion subgroup of $H$.
For odd $\ell$ this torsion has order dividing $\ell - 1$, so it fixes every subextension of
$\ell$-power degree; for $\ell = 2$ it is generated by $\zeta \mapsto \zeta^{-1}$, which is the
restriction of complex conjugation for every complex embedding, so it fixes exactly the totally
real subfields. In both cases such an $E$ lies in $K_\infty$ and hence equals $K_n$; conversely
each $K_n$ is a totally real subfield of some $K(\mu_{\ell^N})$ of degree $\ell^n$ over $K$.
-/
@[category research open, AMS 11]
theorem greenbergs_conjectures.parts.i (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K] [IsTotallyReal K]
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] :
    ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ (n N : ℕ) (E : IntermediateField K (CyclotomicField (ℓ ^ N) K)),
      IsTotallyReal E → Module.finrank K E = ℓ ^ n → padicValNat ℓ (classNumber E) ≤ C := by
  sorry

prime $p$ and every $t$, there exists a $p$-rational number field $K$, Galois over $\mathbb{Q}$,
with $\operatorname{Gal}(K/\mathbb{Q}) \cong (\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^t$.

The case $t = 0$ is included; it holds with $K = \mathbb{Q}$.

import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Greenberg's conjectures

Two open conjectures of Ralph Greenberg in algebraic number theory:

* the **invariants conjecture** (1971/1976): the Iwasawa invariants $\lambda$ and $\mu$ of the
  cyclotomic $\mathbb{Z}_\ell$-extension of a totally real number field vanish, i.e. the exact
  power of $\ell$ dividing the class numbers of the layers of this extension stays bounded;
* the **$p$-rationality conjecture** (2016): for every odd prime $p$ and every $t$ there is a
  $p$-rational number field $K$ with
  $\operatorname{Gal}(K/\mathbb{Q}) \cong (\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^t$.

*References:*
* [Wikipedia, Greenberg's conjectures](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greenberg%27s_conjectures)
* [Wikipedia, List of unsolved problems in mathematics](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_unsolved_problems_in_mathematics)
* R. Greenberg, *On the Iwasawa invariants of totally real number fields*,
  Amer. J. Math. 98 (1976), 263–284.
* R. Greenberg, *Galois representations with open image*,
  Ann. Math. Qué. 40 (2016), 83–119.
* A. Movahhedi, T. Nguyen Quang Do, *Sur l'arithmétique des corps de nombres $p$-rationnels*,
  Séminaire de Théorie des Nombres, Paris 1987–88, Progr. Math. 81 (1990), 155–200.
-/

open NumberField

namespace GreenbergsConjectures

/--
**Greenberg's invariants conjecture.** Let $k$ be a totally real number field and $\ell$ a prime.
Let $k = k_0 \subset k_1 \subset k_2 \subset \cdots$ be the cyclotomic $\mathbb{Z}_\ell$-extension
of $k$, so that $k_n \subseteq k(\mu_{\ell^\infty})$ is cyclic of degree $\ell^n$ over $k$. Then
the exact power of $\ell$ dividing the class number of $k_n$ is bounded as $n \to \infty$. By
Iwasawa's theorem, this says exactly that the Iwasawa invariants of the cyclotomic
$\mathbb{Z}_\ell$-extension of $k$ vanish: $\lambda_\ell(k) = \mu_\ell(k) = 0$.

In the formal statement the layers $k_n$ are described as follows: since $k$ is totally real, the
fields $k_n$ are exactly the totally real intermediate fields
$k \subseteq L \subseteq k(\mu_{\ell^m})$ (for some $m \ge 0$) whose degree $[L : k]$ is a power
of $\ell$. (For odd $\ell$ every such intermediate field of $\ell$-power degree is automatically
totally real; for $\ell = 2$ the condition rules out the non-real subfields such as $k(i)$.) The
conjecture then asserts that the $\ell$-adic valuation of the class numbers of all these fields is
bounded.
-/
@[category research open, AMS 11]
theorem greenbergs_conjectures.parts.i (k : Type*) [Field k] [NumberField k] [IsTotallyReal k]
    (ℓ : ℕ) (hℓ : ℓ.Prime) :
    ∃ B : ℕ, ∀ (m : ℕ) (L : IntermediateField k (CyclotomicField (ℓ ^ m) k)),
      IsTotallyReal L → (∃ n : ℕ, Module.finrank k L = ℓ ^ n) →
        padicValNat ℓ (classNumber L) ≤ B := by
  sorry

variable (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K]

/--
An extension `L / K` of number fields is *unramified outside `p`* if every maximal ideal of
`𝓞 L` not containing `p` (i.e. every finite prime of `L` not above `p`) is unramified over `𝓞 K`.
-/
def IsUnramifiedOutside (p : ℕ) (L : Type*) [Field L] [Algebra K L] : Prop :=
  ∀ (𝔮 : Ideal (𝓞 L)) [𝔮.IsMaximal], (p : 𝓞 L) ∉ 𝔮 → Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt (𝓞 K) 𝔮

/--
The maximal abelian pro-`p` extension of `K` unramified outside `p`, realised inside an algebraic
closure of `K` as the compositum of all finite abelian extensions `L / K` of `p`-power degree
that are unramified at every finite prime of `L` not above `p`.
-/
noncomputable def maximalAbelianProPUnramifiedOutside (p : ℕ) :
    IntermediateField K (AlgebraicClosure K) :=
  ⨆ L : {L : IntermediateField K (AlgebraicClosure K) //
      FiniteDimensional K L ∧ IsGalois K L ∧ IsMulCommutative (L ≃ₐ[K] L) ∧
        IsPGroup p (L ≃ₐ[K] L) ∧ IsUnramifiedOutside K p L}, L.1

/--
A number field `K` is *`p`-rational* if the Galois group of the maximal abelian pro-`p` extension
of `K` unramified outside `p` is isomorphic, as a topological group, to $\mathbb{Z}_p^{r_2 + 1}$,
where $r_2$ is the number of complex places of `K`.

For odd `p` this is equivalent to the usual definition (Movahhedi–Nguyen Quang Do): the Galois
group of the maximal pro-`p` extension of `K` unramified outside `p` is a free pro-`p` group;
equivalently, Leopoldt's conjecture holds for `K` at `p` and the torsion subgroup of the Galois
group of the maximal abelian pro-`p` extension of `K` unramified outside `p` is trivial. For
`p = 2` (where the real places of `K` also play a role) the notions may differ, so this definition
is only intended for odd `p`, the case of Greenberg's conjecture.
-/
def IsPRational (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] : Prop :=
  Nonempty ((maximalAbelianProPUnramifiedOutside K p ≃ₐ[K] maximalAbelianProPUnramifiedOutside K p)
    ≃ₜ* Multiplicative (Fin (InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces K + 1) → ℤ_[p]))

/--
The field of rational numbers is `p`-rational for every odd prime `p`: by the Kronecker–Weber
theorem the maximal abelian pro-`p` extension of $\mathbb{Q}$ unramified outside `p` is the
cyclotomic $\mathbb{Z}_p$-extension, whose Galois group is $\mathbb{Z}_p = \mathbb{Z}_p^{0 + 1}$.
-/
@[category textbook, AMS 11]
theorem isPRational_rat (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hp : Odd p) : IsPRational ℚ p := by
  sorry

/--
**Greenberg's `p`-rationality conjecture.** For every odd prime $p$ and every $t$, there exists a
$p$-rational number field $K$ that is Galois over $\mathbb{Q}$ with
$\operatorname{Gal}(K/\mathbb{Q}) \cong (\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^t$.

(The case $t = 0$ is trivial, with $K = \mathbb{Q}$; the content of the conjecture is $t \ge 1$.)
-/
@[category research open, AMS 11]
theorem greenbergs_conjectures.parts.ii (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hp : Odd p) (t : ℕ) :
    ∃ (K : Type) (_ : Field K) (_ : NumberField K), IsGalois ℚ K ∧
      Nonempty ((K ≃ₐ[ℚ] K) ≃* (Fin t → Multiplicative (ZMod 2))) ∧ IsPRational K p := by
  sorry

end GreenbergsConjectures

import FormalConjecturesUtil

/-!
# Greenberg's conjectures

Two open conjectures of Ralph Greenberg in algebraic number theory.

**Invariants conjecture** (Greenberg, 1971/1976). Let $k$ be a totally real number field and
$\ell$ a prime. Let $k_\infty = \bigcup_n k_n$ be the cyclotomic $\mathbb{Z}_\ell$-extension of
$k$, i.e. the unique subfield of $k(\mu_{\ell^\infty})$ that is Galois over $k$ with group
$\mathbb{Z}_\ell$, and let $k_n$ be its $n$-th layer, the unique subfield with
$[k_n : k] = \ell^n$. Then the Iwasawa invariants vanish: $\lambda_\ell(k) = \mu_\ell(k) = 0$.
By Iwasawa's formula $e_n = \lambda n + \mu \ell^n + \nu$ for the exact power $\ell^{e_n}$ of
$\ell$ dividing the class number of $k_n$, this says exactly that $e_n$ is bounded as
$n \to \infty$; this bounded-class-number form is the one stated here.

**$p$-rationality conjecture** (Greenberg, 2016). For every odd prime $p$ and every $t$ there is
a $p$-rational number field $K$ with
$\operatorname{Gal}(K/\mathbb{Q}) \cong (\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^t$.
Here $K$ is $p$-rational if the Galois group of the maximal pro-$p$ extension of $K$ unramified
outside $p$ is a free pro-$p$ group; equivalently (Movahhedi–Nguyen Quang Do), the Galois group of
the maximal abelian pro-$p$ extension of $K$ unramified outside $p$ is isomorphic to
$\mathbb{Z}_p^{r_2 + 1}$, where $r_2$ is the number of complex places of $K$ (this packages
Leopoldt's conjecture for $(K, p)$ together with the vanishing of the torsion of that group).

*References:*
- [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Greenberg%27s_conjectures)
- [Gr76] Greenberg, Ralph, *On the Iwasawa invariants of totally real number fields*,
  Amer. J. Math. 98 (1976), 263--284.
- [Gr16] Greenberg, Ralph,
  [*Galois representations with open image*](https://arxiv.org/abs/1408.6788),
  Ann. Math. Qué. 40 (2016), 83--119.
- [MN90] Movahhedi, Abbas and Nguyen Quang Do, Thong, *Sur l'arithmétique des corps de nombres
  $p$-rationnels*, Séminaire de Théorie des Nombres, Paris 1987--88, Progr. Math. 81 (1990),
  155--200.
-/

namespace GreenbergsConjectures

/--
**Greenberg's invariants conjecture** [Gr76]: for every totally real number field $k$ and every
prime $\ell$, the Iwasawa invariants of the cyclotomic $\mathbb{Z}_\ell$-extension
$k_\infty / k$ vanish, $\lambda_\ell(k) = \mu_\ell(k) = 0$. Equivalently, the exact power of
$\ell$ dividing the class number of the $n$-th layer $k_n$ of $k_\infty / k$ is bounded as
$n \to \infty$.

Here `K` is the field $k(\mu_{\ell^\infty})$ obtained by adjoining all $\ell$-power roots of
unity, `k_inf` is the cyclotomic $\mathbb{Z}_\ell$-extension $k_\infty$: the unique
intermediate field of `K / k` that is Galois over `k` with Galois group isomorphic to
$\mathbb{Z}_\ell$. Its $n$-th layer $k_n$ is the unique intermediate field
`k_n ≤ k_inf` with $[k_n : k] = \ell^n$.
-/
@[category research open, AMS 11]
theorem greenbergs_conjectures.parts.i (k : Type*) [Field k] [NumberField k] [IsTotallyReal k]
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (K : Type*) [Field K] [Algebra k K]
    [IsCyclotomicExtension (Set.range (ℓ ^ ·)) k K]
    (k_inf : IntermediateField k K) [IsGalois k k_inf]
    (h_inf : Nonempty (Gal(k_inf/k) ≃* Multiplicative ℤ_[ℓ])) :
    ∃ C : ℕ, ∀ (n : ℕ) (k_n : IntermediateField k K) [NumberField k_n], k_n ≤ k_inf →
      Module.finrank k k_n = ℓ ^ n → padicValNat ℓ (classNumber k_n) ≤ C := by

/--
The maximal abelian pro-$p$ extension of the number field `K` unramified outside $p$, realised
inside `AlgebraicClosure K`: the compositum of all finite abelian extensions `L / K` whose Galois
group is a $p$-group and which are unramified at every finite prime of `L` not lying above $p$.
-/
noncomputable def maximalAbelianProPExtUnramifiedOutside (p : ℕ) (K : Type*) [Field K]
    [NumberField K] : IntermediateField K (AlgebraicClosure K) :=
  sSup {L : IntermediateField K (AlgebraicClosure K) | ∃ _ : NumberField L,
    IsAbelianGalois K L ∧ IsPGroup p Gal(L/K) ∧
      ∀ v : HeightOneSpectrum (𝓞 L), (p : 𝓞 L) ∉ v.asIdeal →
        Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt (𝓞 K) v.asIdeal}

/--
A number field `K` is **$p$-rational** if the Galois group of the maximal abelian pro-$p$
extension of `K` unramified outside $p$ is isomorphic to $\mathbb{Z}_p^{r_2 + 1}$, where $r_2$ is

maximal pro-$p$ extension of `K` unramified outside $p$ is a free pro-$p$ group. It is also
equivalent to: Leopoldt's conjecture holds for $(K, p)$ and the torsion subgroup of the Galois
group of the maximal abelian pro-$p$ extension of `K` unramified outside $p$ is trivial.
-/
def IsPRational (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K] : Prop :=
  Nonempty (Gal((maximalAbelianProPExtUnramifiedOutside p K)/K) ≃*
    Multiplicative (Fin (InfinitePlace.nrComplexPlaces K + 1) → ℤ_[p]))

/--

every $t$, there exists a $p$-rational number field $K$, Galois over $\mathbb{Q}$, with
$\operatorname{Gal}(K/\mathbb{Q}) \cong (\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^t$.
-/

end GreenbergsConjectures

Inside an algebraic closure of $k$, let $k = k_0 \subseteq k_1 \subseteq k_2 \subseteq \cdots$
be a tower of subfields of $k(\mu_{\ell^\infty})$ such that $k_n/k$ is cyclic of degree
$\ell^n$. (Such a tower exists and is unique: its union is the cyclotomic
$\mathbb{Z}_\ell$-extension $k_\infty$ of $k$, the unique $\mathbb{Z}_\ell$-extension of $k$
inside $k(\mu_{\ell^\infty})$, and $k_n$ is its $n$-th layer.) Then the power of $\ell$
dividing the class number $h(k_n)$ is bounded as $n \to \infty$, i.e. the Iwasawa invariants
of $k_\infty/k$ satisfy $\lambda_\ell(k) = \mu_\ell(k) = 0$.

The class number of $k_n$ is written as `Nat.card (ClassGroup (𝓞 (K n)))`; it is a positive
integer since `K n` is finite over `k`.
-/
@[category research open, AMS 11]
theorem greenbergs_conjectures.parts.i (k : Type*) [Field k] [NumberField k] [IsTotallyReal k]
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime] (K : ℕ → IntermediateField k (AlgebraicClosure k))
    (hK : ∀ n, K n ≤ adjoin k {ζ | ∃ m : ℕ, ζ ^ ℓ ^ m = 1})
    (hmono : Monotone K)
    (hgal : ∀ n, IsGalois k (K n))
    (hcyc : ∀ n, IsCyclic (K n ≃ₐ[k] K n))
    (hdeg : ∀ n, Module.finrank k (K n) = ℓ ^ n) :
    ∃ B : ℕ, ∀ n, padicValNat ℓ (Nat.card (ClassGroup (𝓞 (K n)))) ≤ B := by
  sorry

/--
A finite extension `L/K` of number fields is *unramified outside `p`* if every nonzero prime
ideal of `𝓞 L` not containing `p` (i.e. not lying above `p`) is unramified over `𝓞 K`.
-/
def IsUnramifiedOutside (p : ℕ) (K L : Type*) [Field K] [Field L] [Algebra K L] : Prop :=
  ∀ (P : Ideal (𝓞 L)) [P.IsPrime], P ≠ ⊥ → (p : 𝓞 L) ∉ P → Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt (𝓞 K) P

/--
The maximal abelian pro-`p` extension of `K` unramified outside `p`, as a subfield of a fixed
algebraic closure of `K`: the compositum of all finite abelian extensions `L/K` of `p`-power
degree that are unramified outside `p`.
-/
noncomputable def maxAbelianPExtension (p : ℕ) (K : Type*) [Field K] :
    IntermediateField K (AlgebraicClosure K) :=
  ⨆ L ∈ {L : IntermediateField K (AlgebraicClosure K) | FiniteDimensional K L ∧ IsGalois K L ∧
    IsMulCommutative (L ≃ₐ[K] L) ∧ IsPGroup p (L ≃ₐ[K] L) ∧ IsUnramifiedOutside p K L}, L

/-- The trivial extension `K/K` is unramified outside any `p`. -/
@[category API, AMS 11]
theorem isUnramifiedOutside_self (p : ℕ) (K : Type*) [Field K] : IsUnramifiedOutside p K K :=
  fun _ _ _ _ ↦ inferInstance

/-- Every finite abelian extension of `K` of `p`-power degree that is unramified outside `p` is
contained in `maxAbelianPExtension p K`. -/
@[category API, AMS 11]
theorem le_maxAbelianPExtension (p : ℕ) (K : Type*) [Field K]
    (L : IntermediateField K (AlgebraicClosure K)) [FiniteDimensional K L] [IsGalois K L]
    [IsMulCommutative (L ≃ₐ[K] L)] (hL : IsPGroup p (L ≃ₐ[K] L))
    (hL' : IsUnramifiedOutside p K L) : L ≤ maxAbelianPExtension p K :=
  le_iSup₂_of_le L ⟨‹_›, ‹_›, ‹_›, hL, hL'⟩ le_rfl

/--
A number field `K` is *`p`-rational* if the Galois group of its maximal abelian pro-`p`
extension unramified outside `p` is isomorphic, as a topological group, to
$\mathbb{Z}_p^{r_2 + 1}$, where $r_2$ is the number of complex places of `K`.

This is the standard equivalent form (Movahhedi–Nguyen Quang Do) of the definition used by
Greenberg: the Galois group of the maximal pro-`p` extension of `K` unramified outside `p`
is a free pro-`p` group. Equivalently, Leopoldt's conjecture holds for `K` at `p` (this is the
rank being $r_2 + 1$) and the torsion subgroup of the Galois group of the maximal abelian
pro-`p` extension of `K` unramified outside `p` is trivial. The equivalence uses that `p` is
odd; for `p = 2` conventions about the infinite places differ, and the conjecture below only
concerns odd `p`.
-/
def IsPRational (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (K : Type*) [Field K] [NumberField K] : Prop :=
  Nonempty ((maxAbelianPExtension p K ≃ₐ[K] maxAbelianPExtension p K) ≃ₜ*
    Multiplicative (Fin (nrComplexPlaces K + 1) → ℤ_[p]))

/--
**Greenberg's $p$-rationality conjecture** (Greenberg 2016, Conjecture 4.2.1). For any odd
prime $p$ and any $t$, there exists a $p$-rational number field $K$, Galois over $\mathbb{Q}$,
such that $\operatorname{Gal}(K/\mathbb{Q}) \cong (\mathbb{Z}/2\mathbb{Z})^t$.

The case $t = 0$ is the (known) $p$-rationality of $\mathbb{Q}$; the content is for $t \geq 1$.
-/
@[category research open, AMS 11]
theorem greenbergs_conjectures.parts.ii (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hp : Odd p) (t : ℕ) :
    ∃ (K : Type) (_ : Field K) (_ : NumberField K) (_ : IsGalois ℚ K),
      Nonempty ((K ≃ₐ[ℚ] K) ≃* Multiplicative (Fin t → ZMod 2)) ∧ IsPRational p K := by
  sorry

end GreenbergsConjectures
attempts.decomposition_objections: The note for parts.i describes k_n as 'the unique subfield of k(μ_{ℓ^∞}) cyclic of degree ℓ^n over k'. This is false for ℓ = 2: for totally real k, Gal(k(μ_{2^∞})/k) ≅ ℤ/2 × ℤ_2, so e.g. for k = ℚ the fields ℚ(i), ℚ(√2), ℚ(√-2) are all cyclic of degree 2 inside ℚ(μ_{2^∞}), and only ℚ(√2) is the first layer of the cyclotomic ℤ_2-extension. Uniqueness holds only for odd ℓ, or once one asks for the whole nested tower (or for totally real layers). The formalization therefore quantifies over the full tower k_0 ⊆ k_1 ⊆ … with cyclic layers of degree ℓ^n inside k(μ_{ℓ^∞}), which pins down the cyclotomic ℤ_ℓ-extension for every prime ℓ. Otherwise the table is fine; the pseudo-null slot cannot be stated with existing primitives (see per-slot).
modeling_decisions: parts.i: the layers of the cyclotomic ℤ_ℓ-extension are characterised, not constructed: the theorem is universally quantified over towers K : ℕ → IntermediateField k (AlgebraicClosure k) with K n ≤ k(μ_{ℓ^∞}), Monotone K, IsGalois k (K n), IsCyclic Gal(K n/k), finrank k (K n) = ℓ^n. Reviewer should check the argument that such a tower exists and is unique (union is a ℤ_ℓ-extension inside k(μ_{ℓ^∞}); Gal(k(μ_{ℓ^∞})/k) ≅ (finite)×ℤ_ℓ has a unique ℤ_ℓ-quotient; layers of a ℤ_ℓ-extension are unique). Existence makes the statement non-vacuous.

parts.i: class number written as Nat.card (ClassGroup (𝓞 (K n))) rather than NumberField.classNumber, to avoid needing a NumberField instance on K n (which follows from hdeg but is not available to instance search). Since K n is finite over k the class group is finite and Nat.card equals the class number; the '0 for infinite types' default is unreachable.
parts.i: k(μ_{ℓ^∞}) is IntermediateField.adjoin k {ζ | ∃ m, ζ ^ ℓ ^ m = 1} inside AlgebraicClosure k. 'Power of ℓ dividing h(k_n) is bounded' is ∃ B, ∀ n, padicValNat ℓ h_n ≤ B.

parts.ii: p-rationality is defined by Gal(K^{ab}_{p}/K) ≃ₜ* ℤ_p^{r₂+1} (Krull topology; Multiplicative (Fin (nrComplexPlaces K + 1) → ℤ_[p])), the standard equivalent of Greenberg's 'free pro-p' definition for odd p (Movahhedi–Nguyen Quang Do; Euler characteristic argument h²(G_S(p),ℤ/p) = δ_Leopoldt + d(T)). Free pro-p groups are not in Mathlib; the abelian form combines 'Leopoldt at p' (ℤ_p-rank r₂+1) and 'torsion trivial' in one condition. The definition is only claimed correct for odd p; the conjecture has hypothesis Odd p.

parts.ii: 'unramified outside p' for a finite extension L/K uses Mathlib's Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt (𝓞 K) P for nonzero primes P of 𝓞 L with p ∉ P (equivalent to e(P)=1 by Algebra.isUnramifiedAt_iff_of_isDedekindDomain). Infinite places are not mentioned, which is harmless for odd p. The maximal abelian pro-p extension unramified outside p is the compositum (iSup) of all finite-dimensional Galois L ⊆ AlgebraicClosure K with IsMulCommutative and IsPGroup p Galois group and IsUnramifiedOutside p K L; the FiniteDimensional restriction keeps Mathlib's unramified notion in its classical Dedekind setting.

parts.ii: t ranges over all of ℕ (the article says 'for any t'); t = 0 is the known p-rationality of ℚ, so this does not change the truth value versus t ≥ 1. The existential field K lives in Type, following WallSunSun.lean.
Gal(K/ℚ) ≅ (ℤ/2ℤ)^t is Nonempty ((K ≃ₐ[ℚ] K) ≃* Multiplicative (Fin t → ZMod 2)), with IsGalois ℚ K assumed (via the canonical ℚ-algebra structure on a char-0 field).

Two @[category API] lemmas (trivial extension is unramified outside p; every qualifying finite extension lies in maxAbelianPExtension) are included as basic tests of the bespoke definitions, both proved.

greenbergs_conjectures.parts.i.why: Stated in the bounded-class-number form (equivalent to λ=μ=0 via Iwasawa's formula, as the decomposition notes prescribe). k is an arbitrary totally real number field ([NumberField k] [IsTotallyReal k]), ℓ an arbitrary prime. The layers k_n are given as a tower K : ℕ → IntermediateField k (AlgebraicClosure k) with K n ≤ k(μ_{ℓ^∞}) = adjoin k {ζ | ∃ m, ζ^(ℓ^m) = 1}, Monotone K, K n/k Galois with cyclic Galois group and finrank = ℓ^n. Such a tower exists and is unique (its union is a ℤ_ℓ-extension inside k(μ_{ℓ^∞}), where Gal ≅ (finite)×ℤ_ℓ has a unique ℤ_ℓ-quotient, and the layers of a ℤ_ℓ-extension are unique), so universally quantifying over it is exactly the statement about the n-th layers of the cyclotomic ℤ_ℓ-extension. Conclusion: ∃ B, ∀ n, padicValNat ℓ (Nat.card (ClassGroup (𝓞 (K n)))) ≤ B.

greenbergs_conjectures.parts.ii.why: For every odd prime p (Fact p.Prime, Odd p) and every t : ℕ there exists a number field K (Type, Field, NumberField, IsGalois ℚ K) with Gal(K/ℚ) ≃* (Fin t → ZMod 2) (written multiplicatively) that is p-rational. p-rationality is defined via the standard equivalent (Movahhedi–Nguyen Quang Do, valid for odd p): the Galois group of the maximal abelian pro-p extension of K unramified outside p (defined as the compositum in AlgebraicClosure K of all finite abelian p-power-degree extensions unramified outside p, using Mathlib's Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt) is ≃ₜ* ℤ_p^{r₂+1} with the Krull topology; this packages 'Leopoldt at p' (rank r₂+1) and 'torsion trivial'.

greenbergs_conjectures.variants.pseudo_n.why: Pseudo-nullity of X̃ = Gal(L̃/F̃) requires the Iwasawa algebra Λ̃ = ℤ_p[[Gal(F̃/F)]] (completed group ring of a profinite group, or equivalently ℤ_p[[T_1,…,T_n]] with the module structure on X̃ obtained by continuity from the conjugation action of topological generators) and the notion of pseudo-null module (annihilator of height ≥ 2 / vanishing at height-one primes). Neither the completed group algebra, its canonical continuous module structure on a profinite Galois group, nor pseudo-nullity exists in Mathlib or FormalConjecturesForMathlib; in addition, the maximal unramified abelian pro-p extension of the infinite extension F̃ needs a notion of unramified prime for non-finite (non-Dedekind) extensions that Mathlib's Algebra.IsUnramifiedAt does not faithfully provide. There is no known elementary (layer-wise) reformulation for n ≥ 2 analogous to the bounded-class-number form, so the slot is omitted.
